verdict.rationale: New Relic's docs describe APM agents automatically adding metadata to logs for 'logs in context', letting developers see log data in various relevant places within the platform (e.g., alongside traces/errors), which directly supports jumping from a span to correlated logs, and NRQL/dashboards let you further correlate with metrics.  missing for 10: explicit documentation of a one-click 'view logs from this trace span' UI flow and independent/hands-on confirmation that metric correlation works seamlessly alongside logs-in-context.
